dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Presence of localized irregular indentation on the posterior-left lateral margin where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Two distinct, parallel longitudinal linear marks on the cranial dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Two parallel longitudinal depressions visible along the anterior dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear scars or rake marks visible on the upper dorsal region.
